**Clinical Diagnosis:**  
- **Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC), lower lip (vermilion border)** — confirmed by biopsy showing dysplasia and keratin pearls  

**Key Risk Factors:**  
- Chronic ultraviolet (UV) radiation exposure (25 years outdoor occupation, no routine sun protection)  
- Tobacco use (1 pack/day × 20 years)
